content: {"praised":["Kristofferson's portrayal of a corrupt sheriff was menacing.","Sayles' writing offers simple, elegant dialogue.","The story explores deep themes of family and history.","Characters have depth and complexity.","The film's tone blends western and drama."],"criticized":["The film feels boring and slow.","It is overly long, 135 minutes.","Political subtext overwhelms the plot.","Stereotypical portrayals of race relations.","The pacing drags and feels interminable."]}
